fml.menu.mods.info.description.enplotify: A typed-out story mode, plus posters, newspapers, documents, blackboards and whiteboards you can write on and illustrate.
enplotify.configuration.title: EnPlotify Configuration
enplotify.hint: Space / Left Click  Continue      Tab + Space  Skip
config.enplotify.text_size.tooltip: Vanilla text is 8. 6 to 96 in steps of 0.5, default 12. Lowered automatically if a page would not fit.
config.enplotify.text_speed.tooltip: 1 is the default speed. 0.1 to 10 in steps of 0.1; -1 turns the typing animation off.
block.enplotify.printer.tooltip.more: Alt+left click: rename; a redstone signal also copies
block.enplotify.printer.tooltip.put: Shift+left click: add paper, Shift+right click: add the original
block.enplotify.printer.tooltip.take: Ctrl+left click: take paper, Ctrl+right click: take the original
block.enplotify.printer.tooltip.print: Right click the top to copy, the tray to take copies
block.enplotify.printer.tooltip.tray: Alt+right click the tray: put in as is; hoppers add paper and take copies
message.enplotify.printer.not_paper: This can't be used as copy paper
message.enplotify.printer.has_original: There is already an original inside
item.enplotify.ghost_item_frame.tooltip: An invisible item frame; the frame shows while you hold one
item.enplotify.poster.tooltip.hint: Right click to edit · Sneak + right click a wall to hang
item.enplotify.blackboard.tooltip.hint: Right click a wall to hang · Right click it with chalk to write
item.enplotify.whiteboard.tooltip.hint: Right click a wall to hang · Right click it with a marker to write
item.enplotify.sheet.tooltip.hint: Right click to edit · Sneak + right click a block top to lay it down
message.enplotify.upload.disabled: Uploads are turned off in this world
message.enplotify.upload.no_chooser: The file chooser did not open; drag the file into the game window instead
enplotify.paper.finalize.tooltip: Once finalised it can only be read. Put it alone in a crafting grid to reset it.
enplotify.paper.title: Title
enplotify.paper.size.title_poster: How big should the poster be?
enplotify.paper.size.title_board: How big should the board be?
enplotify.paper.size.hint: The clicked cell is the lower left
config.enplotify.allow_uploads.tooltip: Whether players may upload pictures for posters, newspapers and documents.
message.enplotify.pile_full: This pile already touches the block above
enplotify.editor.image: Picture (or drag it into the window)
enplotify.editor.font_size_screen: Font size (as shown on screen; 8 px = interface text)
enplotify.paper.name: Name
enplotify.editor.image_animated: Picture, GIF or video (or drag it into the window)
message.enplotify.upload.too_long: Animation too long for this server
message.enplotify.upload.animation_too_l: Animation too large; try a shorter video
message.enplotify.upload.video_unsupport: Could not read this video (H.264 in MP4 / MOV / MKV works)
config.enplotify.max_animation_seconds.t: Longest GIF / video on a poster; longer ones are cut. 1 to 600, default 60.
block.enplotify.terminal.tooltip.place: Right click a wall to hang it, a block top to stand it on a desk
block.enplotify.terminal.tooltip.use: With a keyboard and mouse in the same spot, right click to use
item.enplotify.keyboard.tooltip: Goes into a terminal's spot; needed to use it
message.enplotify.terminal.no_keyboard: Needs a keyboard and mouse in the same spot
message.enplotify.terminal.cannot_import: Hold a document, newspaper or poster
message.enplotify.terminal.printer_gone: That printer can't be found any more
message.enplotify.terminal.sent_no_paper: Queued; the printer has no matching paper
terminal.enplotify.printers_hint: Pick a file in Files and press Print
config.enplotify.terminal.tooltip: How other players' terminal screens look, and the size of the terminal system for you.
config.enplotify.terminal.display.toolti: How a terminal someone else uses looks. Current window: black with the name of the open window. Screenshot: a picture of their screen.
config.enplotify.terminal.fps.tooltip: Screenshot only: new pictures per second, 0 to 60 (decimals allowed), default 5. 0 = only when they switch windows.
config.enplotify.terminal.resolution.too: Screenshot only: how sharp others' screens and displays look (all 16:10). Default 320×200; larger is sharper but uses more network.
config.enplotify.terminal.ui_scale.toolt: Size of the terminal system while you use it, 0.1 to 10: 1 = Minecraft's own interface size, 2 = twice as large. Web pages zoom with it.
message.enplotify.terminal.off: Hey you, don't you turn a computer on before using it?
message.enplotify.terminal.starting: The terminal is starting or shutting down
item.enplotify.display.tooltip.hint: Right click a wall to hang it, any size
item.enplotify.display.tooltip.connect: Connect it in a terminal's Devices; Alt + left click to rename
terminal.enplotify.displays_hint: Click to connect, click again to disconnect
message.enplotify.terminal.display_taken: Another terminal is using this display
Right click a wall to hang · right click with a marker to write
Connect it in a terminal's Devices; the screen plays under the writing. Alt + left click to rename
message.enplotify.terminal.working: This terminal is working; hold Alt and use it to take over
config.enplotify.quest_key.tooltip: The key that opens the quest map; also in Controls → Key Binds
enplotify.quest.hint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, click to view, double-click or arrow to open
enplotify.quest.requirements: Do these to unlock the next stage:
enplotify.quest.open_hint: Press [%s] to open the quest map
